sections.name: component
sections.title: Make a test element

sections.name: parametric primitive library
sections.title: Explicit parts and every shape checks
sections.what: Two tests. The first builds an element from explicit parts and checks its tag, centre, size and rotation. The second builds each listed shape and checks it has meshes, finite bounds and the right element tag.
sections.why: Covers both the explicit recipe path and the built-in shapes.
sections.watch_out: The first test expects exact centre numbers, so changes to rotation or offset rules will break it.

summary: Tests that each named facility shape builds into visible, valid 3D geometry at the right place and size, including an explicit parts recipe.
purpose: Check primitives.ts with a set of test elements.
why: Likely reason: there are many shapes, and one broken builder would produce blank or invalid geometry, so one loop checks them all.
how: Tests an element built from explicit parts: checks its tag, centre, size, and that a cylinder part can be made with a rotation. Then builds every listed shape and checks it has meshes, finite bounds, and the correct element tag.
inputs: Test elements made by the test file, with fixed positions and sizes.
outputs: Pass or fail for each test.
risks: The shape list is written by hand, so a new shape is untested until added. Checks look for valid numbers, not for realistic appearance.
debug: If a single shape fails, its name appears in the test title. Look at that shape's builder in primitives.ts.
